scope: historical milestone promises, live-source integrity, and binary qualification

issues.finding: Declared monomorphizer module missing from uploaded source
issues.remediation: Restored a conservative generic-codegen gate; generics now fail closed until real monomorphization

issues.finding: Declared Cranelift AOT module missing from uploaded source
issues.remediation: Removed stale live declaration; canonical AOT moved to owned codegen-native

issues.finding: run-native routed through in-process Cranelift execution
issues.remediation: Canonical run/build now use owned x86-64 ELF64 AOT; JIT names are noncanonical

issues.finding: Default dependency graph pulled heavyweight development backends into normal builds
issues.remediation: Default-members/default feature closure reduced to native compiler spine

issues.finding: LLVM selection could alias/fall back to another backend
issues.remediation: LLVM execution now fails closed; historical implementation archived

issues.finding: Cranelift development backend could disagree with checked arithmetic/pointer semantics
issues.remediation: Execution backend disqualified/fail-closed pending independent requalification

issues.finding: DCE could delete effectful calls when result unused
issues.remediation: Calls retained unless semantics prove removability

issues.finding: Constant folding could alter divide/overflow behavior or overflow in Rust host
issues.remediation: Faulting operations preserved and checked arithmetic used

issues.finding: Unsupported LIR/source constructs could degrade to Nop/zero-like behavior
issues.remediation: Unsupported constructs use explicit sentinels/errors and native backend rejects them

issues.finding: Missing variables could alias slot zero in lowering
issues.remediation: Slot lookup is checked and unresolved values are errors

issues.finding: Unary negation emitted operands in the wrong order
issues.remediation: Corrected lowering and retained checked-negation semantics

issues.finding: MIR did not preserve function return shape, allowing phantom scalar returns
issues.remediation: Added explicit return-shape metadata and fail-closed scalar ABI checks

issues.finding: Direct calls relied on hard-coded function-name behavior
issues.remediation: Restored parameter flow through MIR/LIR and removed hard-coded add behavior

issues.finding: SysV stack alignment could break nested calls with live expression values
issues.remediation: Native call lowering now preserves x86-64 SysV alignment

issues.finding: Unresolved MIR labels could become instruction-zero-style invalid control flow
issues.remediation: MIR/LIR verifiers reject dangling/duplicate targets

issues.finding: FFI sandbox simulated foreign success by returning zero
issues.remediation: Foreign calls fail with BackendUnavailable until a qualified ABI implementation exists

issues.finding: Compile-time evaluation contained host-overflow/fabricated Unit behavior
issues.remediation: Canonical comptime evaluator uses operation limits, Unit, checked arithmetic and explicit unsupported errors

issues.finding: Legacy macro comptime evaluator used integer zero as Unit and unchecked host arithmetic
issues.remediation: Added Unit, checked arithmetic/counters, and fail-closed sizeof for unknown layouts

issues.finding: Trait registration treated inherent impls as trait impls and over-substituted Self
issues.remediation: Trait registration now distinguishes inherent and trait impls and preserves annotated types

issues.finding: Package resolution could invent a version for unresolved/wildcard dependencies
issues.remediation: v0.1.2 project preparation rejects external dependency resolution until registry identity is qualified

issues.finding: CLI publish/fix scaffolding could look like implemented commands
issues.remediation: Commands report explicit unavailable/unsupported status

issues.finding: Documentation generator fabricated placeholder documentation
issues.remediation: Generator now emits only real extracted documentation; no placeholder text

issues.finding: Mock/experimental ownership engine participated in the apparent canonical soundness path
issues.remediation: Canonical v0.1.2 rejects ownership-sensitive MIR; historical Polonius adapter is archived/fail-closed

issues.finding: Upstream Polonius Git dependency made optional ownership work network/heavy and easy to misclassify
issues.remediation: Removed from baseline lock/dependency graph; compatibility adapter is dependency-free and fail-closed

issues.finding: Raw-pointer generational arena could leak retired allocations and complicated safety reasoning
issues.remediation: Replaced with safe boxed generational slots; stale handles cannot alias reused values

issues.finding: Bootstrap stdlib Arena allowed duplicate release bookkeeping/live-count drift
issues.remediation: Duplicate release rejected and live count derived from actual live slots

issues.finding: Legacy interpreter silently mapped negative/out-of-range indexes and arithmetic faults to invented values or Rust panics
issues.remediation: Indexes/arithmetic are checked and malformed accesses return errors

issues.finding: Legacy interpreter used integer zero for Unit and missing map/Result payloads
issues.remediation: Added Unit; mutating helpers return Unit; missing payload/key paths no longer invent zero

issues.finding: Vector capacity helper returned length rather than capacity
issues.remediation: Corrected legacy interpreter capacity result

issues.finding: LSP malformed/missing positions and versions could default to valid-looking coordinates/state
issues.remediation: LSP request/notification parsing now rejects malformed parameters instead of inventing defaults

issues.finding: Build-graph metadata refresh failure could reuse cached timestamp and miss a rebuild
issues.remediation: Metadata uncertainty now conservatively marks the target stale

issues.finding: build.omni executed through an evaluator without the spec-required hermetic declared-input/output authority model
issues.remediation: v0.1.2 rejects build.omni explicitly; ordinary dependency-free project build remains supported

issues.finding: fmt --check could treat a file read error as empty input
issues.remediation: File-read failures are now fatal diagnostics

issues.finding: Active .omni stdlib prototypes and backup copies looked like implemented Edition-1 library code
issues.remediation: Prototype copies archived; active location explicitly states no qualified Omni-source stdlib yet

issues.finding: Public examples mixed supported native programs with legacy/future syntax experiments
issues.remediation: Only qualified native examples remain active; historical experiments archived

issues.finding: Self-host Stage-0 smoke helper referenced a legacy hello file incompatible with current native-main requirements
issues.remediation: Smoke helper now uses qualified examples/native_hello.omni

issues.finding: Stale agent/contributor guides named Cranelift primary, mock Polonius canonical, and obsolete plans authoritative
issues.remediation: Guides rewritten around native-first closure, fail-closed rule and current sources of truth

issues.finding: Multiple obsolete plans/audits/spec copies remained active and contradicted current state
issues.remediation: Historical originals archived; public paths are redirects or current audit documents

issues.finding: break/continue lacked dependable lexical target/cleanup semantics
issues.remediation: Implemented loop-context lowering, cleanup-aware jumps and illegal-use diagnostics

issues.finding: MIR control flow lacked an independent duplicate/dangling label gate
issues.remediation: Added backend-independent MIR structural verifier

issues.finding: Historical compatibility was described but not retained as an executable corpus in the evolved tree
issues.remediation: Added five-case v0.0.1 compatibility corpus and runner

issues.finding: Release gate used --workspace and therefore mixed future/unqualified crates into native-core qualification
issues.remediation: Qualification scripts now use default members; research crates require separate qualification

issues.finding: Source verifier alone could be mistaken for build/semantic qualification
issues.remediation: Added adversarial lineage audit and explicit source-qualified/Cargo-unverified metadata

issues.finding: Cargo.lock retained dependencies for archived heavy ownership/backend experiments
issues.remediation: Pruned obsolete heavy packages while retaining manifests needed by active workspace packages

issues.finding: INSTALL.md still claimed that project builds execute build.omni even after the build-script path was deliberately made fail-closed
issues.remediation: Installation/project-workflow documentation now states the dependency-free single-entry boundary and explicit build.omni/external-dependency rejection

issues.finding: The Rust bootstrap toolchain floated on the stable channel, allowing source-identical bootstrap qualification to change with future compiler releases
issues.remediation: Pinned rust-toolchain to Rust 1.97.1 with minimal profile plus rustfmt/clippy; source verification enforces the pin

issues.finding: Later remediation documents reused early version numbers for native milestones and obscured the original cumulative 0.0.1/0.0.2/0.1.0/0.1.1/0.1.2 contracts
issues.remediation: Added an authoritative historical milestone closure that preserves original version meanings and treats native hardening as cumulative additional work

issues.finding: Visibility parsed before error-set declarations was discarded because ErrorSet carried no visibility field
issues.remediation: ErrorSet AST/parser/formatter now preserve visibility; historical regression coverage added

issues.finding: Strict formatter behavior existed only as a library configuration and was not exposed by the CLI formatter command
issues.remediation: omni fmt now accepts --strict and composes it with --check; unknown formatter options fail explicitly

issues.finding: Rustfmt drift remained after source-only remediation
issues.remediation: Applied rustfmt across the workspace and made formatting a verified binary-promotion gate

issues.finding: Channel capacity lowering had a u32-to-i64 compile mismatch
issues.remediation: Added checked integer conversion at the interpreter boundary

issues.finding: Monomorphizer used an invalid Rust or-pattern across boxed/unboxed expression forms
issues.remediation: Split the unsupported/generic gate match arms so the bootstrap compiler builds correctly

issues.finding: Legacy interpreter print handling was non-exhaustive after Unit became a real value
issues.remediation: Added explicit Unit formatting and kept value matching exhaustive

issues.finding: Clippy exposed dead semantic context parameters and warning debt in the canonical closure
issues.remediation: Removed fake recursive context plumbing and fixed all warnings; default and workspace Clippy pass with -D warnings

issues.finding: Freshly emitted native executables could hit Linux ETXTBSY in temporary-file execution tests
issues.remediation: Made temporary artifact names unique and added bounded retry only for Linux ETXTBSY after the writer is closed

issues.finding: Functions without explicit return annotations were forced to Unit despite returning values
issues.remediation: Added function-local return inference and updated resolved function signatures after body checking

issues.finding: Cross-module visibility could authorize an import while type checking still treated the imported function as undefined
issues.remediation: Module-aware checking now imports only explicitly used, visibility-authorized function signatures

issues.finding: Formatter-emitted semicolon separators could fail parser round-trip at program/block boundaries
issues.remediation: Parser trivia/recovery now treats explicit semicolons consistently as statement separators

issues.finding: Scoped import paths and reserved import/visibility words were parsed inconsistently
issues.remediation: Parser now accepts dot/:: scoped paths and tokenized keywords such as friend/cap/mod/in/as in their grammar roles

issues.finding: Stmt::Assign existed throughout semantic/lowering layers but the parser never constructed plain assignments
issues.remediation: Added statement-level identifier assignment parsing before expression parsing

issues.finding: Pipeline tests encoded stale behavior for malformed source and disabled Wasm output
issues.remediation: Tests now enforce fail-closed parser behavior and explicit unqualified-backend diagnostics

issues.finding: Foreign binding export tests overclaimed aggregate ABI/layout support
issues.remediation: Scalar binding export remains qualified; aggregate binding export now fails closed until the layout milestone

issues.finding: Future aggregate/trait semantic tests were mixed into the v0.1.2 pass/fail claim
issues.remediation: Retained those tests but explicitly ignored them with post-v0.1.2 milestone reasons; no feature claim is inferred from parser scaffolding

issues.finding: Brace-form struct parsing stopped at RBrace without consuming it, corrupting following declarations and formatter round-trips
issues.remediation: Consumed closing braces for ordinary/generic struct bodies and added RBrace/Semi type-expression delimiters

issues.finding: Retained Wasm crate failed whole-workspace compilation due incompatible match-arm result types
issues.remediation: Normalized Wasm instruction emission arms to unit-valued statements; workspace build is green

issues.finding: LLVM compatibility tests referenced detection APIs removed during fail-closed quarantine
issues.remediation: Replaced stale tests with explicit unqualified/fail-closed LLVM boundary tests

issues.finding: Source audits treated local target/ and offline vendor/ caches as shipped active source, making post-build qualification self-contradictory
issues.remediation: Added worktree mode that excludes generated/third-party roots while retaining strict lean-source-package checks

issues.finding: Historical Stage-0 `module package.path;` declarations were parsed as executable expressions
issues.remediation: Added transitional historical module-declaration parsing as a non-executable declaration; 0.0.1 corpus now passes 5/5

issues.finding: Identifier-valued control conditions such as `if flag {}` were misparsed as struct literals
issues.remediation: Added expression-before-block parser context that suppresses trailing struct-literal interpretation for control-flow block boundaries

issues.finding: Seven-argument native rejection used unstable wording that drifted from the conformance contract
issues.remediation: Stabilized SysV scalar ABI diagnostic to state that v0.1.2 accepts at most six parameters

issues.finding: Release qualification hard-required cargo-fuzz even in the offline bundle despite the normative requirement being duration-based fuzzing
issues.remediation: Kept mandatory deterministic >=60s lexer/parser fuzzing self-contained and made cargo-fuzz an optional deeper oracle on Unix and PowerShell

summary.note: Future roadmap features are not baseline defects when they fail closed and are not claimed by v0.1.2.
